title: Circulation Section
description: This section is responsible for the checking out and checking in of the materials, management of collection and other related services to users. The following are the major functions of the Section: Circulation Desk Activities, renewals, hold & recalls, book reserves, notifying and searching items, and user assistance.

items.title: Book Lending
items.description: Fiction books may be borrowed and taken out for a week. The books may be renewed for another week. University officials, faculty members, and academic and administrative personnel shall be restricted to a one-week loan period depending on the availability of copies.

items.title: Book Return
items.description: Borrowers are advised to drop items at the designated bin or book drops. If the borrowers want to return the borrowed materials directly to the counter, they are allowed to do so.

items.title: Renewal
items.description: Students and Faculty can renew borrowed books via the University Library email (library@pup.edu.ph) or message the Facebook Page of the library. There are allotted 3 copies with different titles for the renewal of the borrowed library materials per library user.

items.title: Overdue & Fines
items.description: Library resources not returned on the due date shall be subject to fines until they are returned. A fine of fifty (php50.00) pesos per day except Sundays, holidays, and fortuitous events is charged for resources kept overdue.

title: Reference Section
description: This Section is responsible for the checking out and checking in of the materials, management of collection and other related services to users. It also houses the general reference materials like atlas and maps, dictionaries, encyclopedias, bibliographies, research handbooks and guides, catalogs, and directories.

items.title: Research Assistance
items.description: Librarians assist patrons in finding information, locating resources, and navigating databases. This includes providing answers to questions about the location of materials and services provided within the PUP Libraries.

items.title: Database Navigation
items.description: Guidance on using online databases such as Emerald Insight, ProQuest, and Gale.

items.title: Reader's Advisory
items.description: Personalized recommendations and assistance to meet individual library needs and problems with the Librarian on desk.

title: Filipiniana Section
description: This Section organizes, and preserves all forms of Filipiniana collections regarding the Philippines and the peoples and culture of the Philippines regardless of author, imprint and language. It prepares guides to the various collections to facilitate easy access and retrieval.

items.title: Philippine Literature
items.description: Collection of Filipino literary works including novels, poetry, and short stories in Filipino and English.

items.title: History & Culture
items.description: Historical documents, cultural studies, and materials on Philippine heritage and traditions.

items.title: Government Documents
items.description: Official publications from Philippine government agencies and local government units.

title: Periodical Section
description: This Section is responsible for all functions related to obtaining and making serials available in the library. These include: Indexing of newspapers/journals, claiming unreceived issues, binding and maintaining holdings records in the Library Catalog.

items.title: Newspapers
items.description: Current and back issues of major national and local newspapers available for reading in the library.

items.title: Academic Journals
items.description: Scholarly journals across multiple disciplines. Older issues may be available in bound volumes.

items.title: Magazines
items.description: General interest and specialized magazines covering current events, science, technology, and more.
